caption.text: This Line chart projects the value of Discount over 3 future Order Date periods. The grey area on the right of the chart shows forecasted values. Forecast is calculated using seasonal ARIMA algorithm, with a 95% confidence interval. This visualization allows to project a probable expectation of upcoming Discount Values. Algorithm as well as confidence level can be changed by tuning the visualization properties.
